gaps.note: A property this transition declares that no emitted rule animates. Realizing it means inferring which selector represents a trigger like `openness=closed→open`; that inference is unsolved and is exactly where per-component emitter lore would accumulate (see ContractMotion in contract.ts). Ledgered so the declared-but-unrealized set cannot grow while the lowering stays open.

Component-local motion slot declared in the contract's motion block but never in its tokens sidecar, so the reference lowers to a --fsds-* name the graph does not declare. NOT repaired here, deliberately: adding the slot while nothing consumes it would immediately register as a dead slot in RAIL-STYLING-REALIZATION-LEDGERS-01, trading one ledger entry for another. It can only be repaired together with the transition lowering that would give it a var() consumer.
